post.title: This firm took in $8.6 million a day on pennies
post.ig:
This firm took in $8.6 million a day on pennies.
Virtu Financial averaged $8.6M a day in adjusted net trading income in 2025 ($2.1B for the year, FY2025 10-K).
Market makers earn the bid-ask spread: in an example, buying at $100.00 and selling at $100.01 on 1 million shares captures $10,000, unless the price moves first (inventory risk).
Brokers received about $4.4B in payment for order flow in 2025, per Moody's analysis of 14 brokers. Critics see a conflict; supporters say it funds $0 commissions.
Sources: Virtu FY2025 10-K and 2014 IPO filing, Moody's (via Investment Executive).
